replacement_or_supplementary_sources.what_it_supports: 500% YoY spoofing increase in 2024; 1,500 flights/day spoofed by August 2024 vs 300 in Q1/Q2 2024. 950-participant workgroup. Fetched via markitdown.
FAA GNSS Interference Resource Guide v1.1 with daily spoofing trend charts Jan 2024-Jun 2025 across regions. Cites IATA 65% increase per 1,000 flights H1 2024 vs 2023.
Confirms scale/severity increase; ~80% increase in GPS outage events 2021-2024; spoofing indicators continued to climb Aug 2024 - Jan 2025.
EASA-IATA 4-pillar mitigation plan; 122,000+ flights affected in first 4 months of 2025.
ZHAW SkAI live spoofing tracker using OpenSky Network data; ~700 daily 2024 figure originates from media coverage of this tracker.

revised_claim_text: Aviation GNSS interference (primarily spoofing, measured by affected flights/day via ADS-B) ranged from ~300/day in Q1 2024 to peak ~1,500/day in August 2024, averaging ~700/day across 2024, and trending above 1,000/day in early-mid 2025 — a 500% YoY increase (OPSGROUP Sep 2024; FAA Mar 2026; Aireon Apr 2025). Counts reflect aviation-sector incidents detected via ADS-B; total GNSS interference across all transport modes (maritime, road) is considerably higher. EASA+IATA reported 122,000+ flights affected in first 4 months of 2025.

All PDFs fetched via markitdown.
notes: Original gpspatron.com source replaced with FAA + OPSGROUP + Aireon + EASA-IATA primary stack. Numbers are aviation-specific (not all-sector global). Upgrade Low → Medium (not High because exact 2025 figure is a trend interpolation, not single-source primary).
